notes: SC TO-C pre-commencement communication (press release and proxy supplement). It announces an issuer tender offer of up to $50 million at 95 percent of NAV, contingent on shareholder approval at the August 20 2021 special meeting and on Board approval. The tender offer has not commenced in this filing, so commencement, expiration, share count and proration are null, and the $50 million is a dollar size, not a share count, so size_shares is null. The excerpt also describes a proposed conversion to a diversified holding company (a business change proposal). It is not coded as a separate event: the reader judged it not to fit cef_tender, merger or liquidation as stated. The conversion timeline is about 24 months per the filing. fund_type closed_end_fund is the filing's own description (a closed-end fund).
